about_the_game:
You are Tlatoani, the undisputed leader of the Aztec people. Your task: Build a city on the treacherous land of Lake Texcoco and defend it against the nightly attacks of the Moon Goddess and her merciless servants. With the Official Companion at your side, you will not only find all the help and tips to overcome the odds and lead the Aztec civilization to glory. You will also get background information on the history of the Aztecs, their belief systems, their architecture and much more.

Content includes:

  • Game overview
  • City building & strategic map
  • Defending your creation
  • Building overview
  • Research and technology tree
  • Terraforming
  • The Blood Zone
  • The Aztec world of belief
  • The myth of Tenochtitlan
  • Aztec gods
  • The Aztec calendar
  • Rituals, rites and ceremonies
  • Historical context
  • Aztec architecture

and much more...

IMPORTANT INFO: After the "installation", the book will be saved as a PDF in your game folder. You can find them in the game folder of Steam, which can be found in a standard installation under "Steam\steamapps\common\Aztecs The Last Sun".

Please note: The official guide book for Aztecs: The Last Sun is only available in English and German.
